    Rainbow Goddess Pot

    Type Materials
    Enhancer Pts 4
    Enhancer Cost 1200
    Zeni Sales Price 400
    Arena Coins 150

    Basic Information
    Description
    This small artificial goddess was created by accident as a result of attempts to create a divine being that were carried out long ago. It falls far short of the power of a deity, but its body can secrete a large amount of Alchemia. This rainbow-colored goddess contains a special type of energy.
    Attributes
    Can be used to evolve Phantoms of all elements
